rows.text: The PT's PED 2025 vote totalization, stamped 15/07/2025 13:41, gives the candidacies as printed '180 EDINHO' 378,009 votes (73.1%), '150 ROMENIO PEREIRA' 58,845 (11.4%), '130 RUI FALCAO' 57,750 (11.2%) and '120 VALTER POMAR' 22,581 (4.4%), with 517,185 valid and 548,897 total votes; it includes Maranhão's results under the national organization secretariat's (SORG) supervision.
